# Third-party runtime
- MediaPipe Tasks Audio @0.10.35, Apache License 2.0, https://github.com/google-ai-edge/mediapipe
- Official YAMNet AudioSet TFLite model, https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/audio_classifier/yamnet/float32/1/yamnet.tflite
- This package is for on-device research sound-event candidates only; not a cat-language decoder.
- The model runs on-device. Google notes that MediaPipe may send performance/usage metrics; review https://www.npmjs.com/package/@mediapipe/tasks-audio before deploying beyond a beta.
